name: Girls Night Out
source:
You were in a lovely married relationship with your wife for many years. One day, your wife decided to go out with her co-workers and have a Girls Night Out.Little did you know, that Girls Night Out has turned your marriage and relationship upside-down.

Uncover the truth behind what happened to your wife and what your next steps would be!

[From F95Zone]
translation:
多年来，你与妻子一直保持着美好的婚姻关系。有一天，你的妻子决定和她的同事一起出去参加一场“女孩之夜”。但你却不知道，“女孩之夜”已经彻底颠覆了你们的婚姻和关系。

揭开你妻子身上发生的事情的真相以及你的下一步行动！

[来自F95Zone]
